content.text: 3. APPLY ADHESIVE AT CLIP INSTALLATION AREA

content.description: Illustration showing application of adhesive at clip installation areas on body and moulding

items: (a) Place the moulding onto the body.
(b) Pry up the clips on the body side and install to the moulding.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of upper moulding onto body with clips being installed

content.text: (c) Tap the moulding with your hand to fasten the clips at the glass edge.
At the same time, install the fasteners by tapping them by hand.

content.description: Illustration showing tapping of moulding by hand to fasten clips at glass edge and installation of fasteners

content.text: (d) If the moulding is not at the same level as the body, insert a scraper between them and tap on the moulding while pushing on the fastener.

content.description: Illustration showing use of scraper between moulding and body while tapping moulding and pushing on fastener to level moulding

content.text: 5. INSTALL SIDE MOULDING IN SAME MANNER AS FOR UPPER MOULDING

items: (b) Install the joint cover to the upper moulding.
(c) Connect the side moulding into the joint cover.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of joint cover by sliding side moulding down and connecting to upper moulding
